svg.text: three monitors · he faces NORTH, back to the room
darts in the WALL around it · cans · crates
is on the CRT, never here
the one corner proven end to end (S04)
fifty taped concepts · string lights · worktable
the moodboard wraps the SE corner
S05 looks SOUTH at the moodboard,
so EAST is its frame-LEFT — and the
CRT hangs on the east wall right
above the shelving that sits at that
So the television belongs in the
Gemini plate: small, top-left, in the
corner of frame. It is not there.
That is the continuity hole, stated
as geometry rather than as a worry —
and it is also the fix for beat 3,
because the alarm can then cut from
a frame the TV is already in.
About-Me short · the spatial authority. Every zone here is read off a plate that already exists; the plan was fitted to the frames, not imposed on them.
Nothing moves between shots. When a new angle invents a zone, ratify that plate first — it becomes the zone’s bible.
camera position; the dashed wedge is what that lens contains
solid = a fixture against a wall · ticked panels = taped sheets or binders
red = a note to a human, never set content
02 Sean, medium from behind · 03 Claude’s nook · 04 Codex’s rack (proven end to end)
05 Gemini’s moodboard · 06 Grok’s dartboard · 07 the CRT alarm · there is no establishing wide
